Name: DW3 Agumon Dinosaur Replacer
Author: boofdawg
Description:
ALL CREDITS TO Dragonyck's Agumon Dino replacer!!!     
﻿After seeing his beautiful mod I wanted to try my hand at recoloring his sprites.  Played Digimon World 3 back in the day and remembered there were Agumon suits. One was a blue Agumon for the player, the other a pink suit for a npc.  This is my attempt at those suits.

﻿His original mod : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2164       I highly suggest you grab it <3

Downloads.Description: This contains 2 folders. One for the blue and the other pink. (Put one dino in the animals folder)
